stage_executor/ports.py: start(execution_input: ExecutionInput) -> ExecutionHandle; resume(resume_input: ResumeInput) -> ExecutionHandle; cancel(cancel_request: ExecutionCancelRequest) -> CancelReceipt; inspect(run_id: str) -> ExecutionSnapshot.
